notes: The Library opens on a short rail of three tabs - Streaming, Library and Albums - so the stream shelf, your files and your albums never share one scroll again.
Streaming is a panel of its own now: it slides in from the right over the list, and the list keeps the place it was in while it is open.
Your pinned artists sit at the top of the shelf as chips - one tap searches that artist - and Recommended seeds a mix from whoever you are streaming.
The transport and the add and remove buttons are drawn as icons instead of characters, so a WebView can no longer render one of them as an emoji, and the play button takes your theme’s colour.

A stream is resolved by the same call the converter is built on, so a song that would download now plays: both clients asked at once, headers that name the client the request declares, a ciphered row decrypted, and the audio streams tried before the muxed ones.
